summary: Dedicated childcare worker with over 10 years of experience maintaining safe, engaging environments for young children in group care settings. Skilled in developmental monitoring, parent communication, and hygiene protocols.

experience.title: Lead Childcare Worker
experience.employer: a mid-size regional early learning center
bullets: Maintain a safe and sanitary play environment for up to 18 children daily, sanitizing toys and equipment each session.
Observe and document children's play activities and behaviors, keeping daily records on meals, activities, and medications administered.
Communicate with guardians about daily activities, behaviors, and developmental progress through written logs and brief conferences.
Support emotional and social development by modeling positive interactions and encouraging understanding of others.

experience.title: Childcare Assistant
bullets: Monitored indoor and outdoor play activities for groups of 12-15 children, intervening promptly to prevent unsafe situations.
Assisted with dressing, diaper changes, and toileting routines while maintaining children's dignity and hygiene.
Sanitized play equipment and rest areas throughout the day, reducing illness-related absences by an estimated 20%.
Kept individual records of daily observations, meals served, and medication administration for guardian review.

experience.title: Childcare Aide
bullets: Observed and monitored children's play activities, noting developmental milestones and sharing observations with lead staff.
Supported children's emotional and social growth by facilitating cooperative play and positive self-concept activities.
Maintained a clean and safe classroom environment, routinely sanitizing toys and play surfaces.
Communicated with guardians about daily activities and any behavioral or health-related concerns.

experience.title: Early Childhood Care Provider
experience.employer: a regional school for children with disabilities
bullets: Cared for children in an institutional setting, providing individualized attention to support daily routines and safety.
Observed and documented play activities and behaviors to inform care plans and guardian updates.
Assisted with dressing, feeding, and diaper changes as needed, following health and safety protocols.
Sanitized toys and adaptive play equipment daily to maintain a hygienic environment.

education.degree: Associate of Applied Science in Early Childhood Education
